Keep every main set crisp and leave 1-2 reps in reserve unless the note says otherwise. The priority is strong practice with low spillover into BJJ/MMA, not grinders.

Weeks 2-4: add reps first on the rep box squat, add small load only when bar speed and position stay clean, build One-Arm Pull-up quality by more total clean singles or less assistance, and progress Overhead Press/Push Press in small steps without forcing misses.

If low back symptoms rise, keep box height strict to parallel, brace harder, and reduce box squat load 5-10%. If elbow or biceps tendon gets irritated on One-Arm Pull-up work, keep the strict exposure but cut 1-2 sets and use slightly more help on Assisted One-Arm Pull-up. Skip any rep that shifts hard through the spine or loses shoulder position.
